label: Storage in MySQL
description: An @storage engine that keeps records in the InnoDB tables of one MySQL database, 8.0.16 or later, through Kysely and mysql2. It grants one connection kind and no port: what may be asked of a store is @storage's business, and this plugin only answers it in SQL. A collection is a table, a field is a column, and what the store declares -- the key, what is unique, what refers to what -- is what the database is asked to hold. Engine-wide knobs live in these settings; the URL and the pool are facts about one database and live on its connection.

statementTimeout.description: how many seconds a read may run before the server stops it, set as the session's MAX_EXECUTION_TIME. MySQL applies it to reads alone: a write has no server-side deadline. Absent: the server's own setting stands.

keyType.description: what newKey answers: uuidv7 for a string key, identity (one past the highest the collection has had, reserved in the wilanis_keys table) for a number key. Absent: uuidv7.
